status: frozen before implementation or results; maintainer-approved 2026-10-12
purpose: PBRT-free go/stop gate: conventional comparator competence and controller identifiability; no TC image-quality comparison

policies_under_test.source: unchanged experiments/tc-r1/baselines.py and tc_controller.py; hashes recorded in the result

simulator.frame: 32x32 pixels; 64 immutable 4x4 regions (8x8 grid); every pixel in a region shares one per-sample distribution
simulator.state: RegionState fields computed with the progressive_kernel.py formulas: mean and variance are area means of per-pixel mean and unbiased variance; standard_error = sqrt(sum_p m2/((n-1)n))/area; recent_improvement = sum SE^2 before minus after for the last request on that region, None when before-n<2; estimated_sample_cost from the last request on that region, None before it; charged_rays cumulative int
simulator.deviation: NumPy per-pixel moments replace ProgressiveKernel's Python per-pixel loop for speed; ProgressiveKernel correctness is established separately by PR #22
simulator.requests: 4 spp per request; mandatory 16-spp initialization by the policies' own coverage rule; channel factors (1.0, 0.7, 0.4) on one shared draw

fields.gaussian: mu_r ~ U(0.2,1); sigma_r = 0.5*exp(N(0,1)); sample = mu_r + sigma_r*Z
fields.rare-spike: mu_r ~ U(0.2,1); sample = mu_r + 0.05*Z + 200*Bernoulli(p_r); 8 of 64 regions (chosen by the seeded generator) have p_r ~ U(0.002,0.02), others p_r = 0
fields.scale_rule: the same underlying draws are multiplied by the scale (common random numbers)
fields.seed_derivation: first 8 big-endian bytes of SHA-256('tc-r1-offline-gate-v1|field|seed'); scale does not enter the seed

competence.metric: efficiency eta = E_oracle / E_policy, E = sum_r area*mean_c(sigma_rc^2)/n_r using TRUE per-sample variances and the final per-region allocation; E_oracle = continuous water-filling minimum with n_r >= 16 and equal total samples
competence.aggregation: mean eta over the three seeds for each method/field/scale/horizon

criteria.C1: gaussian and lognormal: eta_method >= 0.80 at every scale and horizon
criteria.C2: gaussian and lognormal: eta_method >= eta_uniform - 0.01 at every scale and horizon
criteria.C3: rare-spike: eta_method >= 0.90 * eta_uniform at every scale and horizon
criteria.C4: every field and horizon: max over scales minus min over scales of eta_method <= 0.05

competence.verdict: COMPETENT for a method only if C1-C4 all hold; strong-baseline verdict is the MC-UCB verdict, variance-guided reported alongside

identifiability.scope: scale 1, horizon 256, all fields and seeds; decision agreement only, no image quality involving the controller is computed

ray_cost_fields.homogeneous: every region charges 2 rays per sample
ray_cost_fields.heterogeneous: rays per sample rho_r ~ integer U{1..17}, independent of noise, from the same seeded generator

cost_measures.wall: estimated_sample_cost = (0.3 + 1e-6*rays_in_request) * exp(N(0,0.1)) / samples_in_request; models per-request process launch plus per-ray work with 10% timing noise

identifiability.shadow: full and equal-cost TcPolicy instances receive every state of the variance-guided trajectory; d = fraction of post-initialization decisions whose region differs from variance-guided. d_eq_nonexplore excludes decisions the controller labels exploration
identifiability.no_feedback: reported only: total-variation distance between its own final allocation fractions and variance-guided's
identifiability.verdict: DISTINCT if mean delta_cost >= 0.10 or mean d_eq_nonexplore >= 0.10; otherwise COLLAPSED. NOISE-DRIVEN flag if mean delta_noise >= 0.10

gate_verdict.AMEND-BASELINE: controller DISTINCT but MC-UCB not COMPETENT; a pre-outcome comparator amendment is required before GO
gate_verdict.noise_rule: if NOISE-DRIVEN, replacing the wall-clock cost predictor is required before any execution freeze, whatever the verdict

limits: one execution after this contract is committed; pure Python/NumPy; no PBRT, rendering, primary scene, reference or network; no policy parameter changes in response to results except through a separately registered amendment justified independently of them
interpretation_limits: synthetic fields do not establish corpus behavior; DISTINCT means different decisions, not better ones; a GO authorizes only the next design amendment and bounded local measurement
